details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which sends an HTTP POST of host metadata — package name, hostname, install path, working directory, npm user-agent and protocol — to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an X-Beacon-Package header. The same beacon also fires when index.js is required; index.js exports a no-op Proxy so that imports of the real package do not fail. No credentials, tokens, environment values or file contents are collected or transmitted.
